summary: Iteration 5 retest of the four iteration-4 fixes. BLOCKER FOUND AND FIXED BY QA: /app/frontend/src/pages/Settings.js contained TWO `export default function Settings()` declarations (new version lines 1-180 + stale old copy lines 182-341) -> webpack SyntaxError 'Identifier Settings has already been declared', the whole React app served the CRA error overlay and NO page could load (this is why iteration 4 appeared to be missing the UI blocks). I truncated the file to the first 180 lines (removed the duplicated stale block) and the app compiles again. After that all 4 fixes verified: (1) POST /api/missions/{id}/duplicate now returns 402 for a free user at quota (no mission created) and 200 for pro; (2) /onboarding reaches data-testid='onboarding-final' with CTA 'Créer mon compte gratuit' and POST /api/onboarding fires only on that last click (verified via request interception: 0 posts before, 1 after); (3) /pricing no longer contains '4242'; (4) Dashboard plan-quota-banner (free: 'Missions actives 1/1 · Intervenants 14/10') and plan-pro-banner (pro) both render; Settings settings-subscription-block renders with settings-upgrade-link (free) and settings-portal-btn (pro) which really redirects to https://billing.stripe.com/p/session. Backend: 62/62 pytest pass (14 new iteration-5 + 48 iteration-3/4 regression). Frontend regression: login, missions list/detail (6 shifts), calendar, historique, intervenants, SMS test (Twilio TRIAL French error toast) all OK.

rca_of_the_issue: Iteration-4 'missing UI blocks' RCA: the blocks WERE implemented, but Settings.js was written with the new component appended in front of the old one, leaving two `export default function Settings()` declarations. Babel raised 'Identifier Settings has already been declared (182:24)', webpack served the CRA error overlay for every route, so login itself was impossible and no testid could be found. Removing the stale duplicate restored the build and all blocks render correctly. Duplicate-quota fix confirmed at server.py L775 (`await check_quota_or_raise(user, 'mission')` before the 404 lookup) — note the quota check runs before the mission-exists check, so duplicating an unknown id as a free user at quota returns 402 instead of 404 (acceptable, but worth knowing).
